findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 914 requests to 185 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 8.4 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 6.3 MB (76%) came from third-party domains, 3.1 MB of it from services classified as tracking (661 requests).

95 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads-twitter.com (X, advertising).
343 cookies were set by third-party domains (401 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
